name: How long does it take to install a new sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a new sliding glass door typically depends on the project's complexity. A straightforward replacement where the new door fits the existing opening might take one day. However, projects requiring frame modifications, structural adjustments, or addressing unforeseen issues with the wall opening could extend the timeline to two or more days. We prioritize efficient, high-quality work to minimize disruption, and our team will provide a clear timeline estimate during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes one day for simple replacements, but complex projects with structural modifications may take two or more days.
